course_description: Study of fundamental data structures, recursive algorithms, dynamic memory, sorting, trees, and algorithmic complexity.

course_outcomes.co_description: Implement linear and non-linear data structures using appropriate programming languages to solve specific computational problems.
Analyze the time and space complexity of various algorithms to determine their efficiency for given input sizes.
Design optimized sorting and searching algorithms based on specific constraints and performance requirements.
Develop recursive functions and dynamic memory management techniques to handle complex data processing tasks.
